verdict.rationale: Feitian documents HOTP functionality that emulates HID keyboard to auto-type OTP values, plus an OTP Tool to switch protocols and an SK Manager to manage OTP/PIV/FIDO functions, confirming legacy OTP slot support beyond WebAuthn. However, there's no detail on TOTP support, challenge-response mode, or number of OTP slots available. Missing for 10: TOTP-specific documentation, challenge-response mode details, slot capacity/configuration specifics, and independent hands-on verification.
